metadata.title: Plug Power Stock Jumps as Earnings Beat Points to Profitability, Say Analysts<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Plug Power Stock Jumps as Earnings Beat Points to Profitability, Say Analysts
Shares of Plug Power rose sharply Tuesday after the hydrogen technology production company posted strong second-quarter results and raised full-year revenue guidance.
